package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"strings"
	"sync"

	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/credentials/insecure"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/health"
	hv1 "google.golang.org/grpc/health/grpc_health_v1"

	"github.com/prince776/go-dst-kit/realworld"
)

var __w = realworld.New(realworld.Options{})

var (
	mu    sync.Mutex
	order []string
)

func tag(name string) grpc.UnaryServerInterceptor {
	return func(ctx context.Context, req any, _ *grpc.UnaryServerInfo, h grpc.UnaryHandler) (any, error) {
		mu.Lock()
		order = append(order, name)
		mu.Unlock()
		return h(ctx, req)
	}
}

func ctag(name string) grpc.UnaryClientInterceptor {
	return func(ctx context.Context, method string, req, reply any, cc *grpc.ClientConn, inv grpc.UnaryInvoker, opts ...grpc.CallOption) error {
		mu.Lock()
		order = append(order, name)
		mu.Unlock()
		return inv(ctx, method, req, reply, cc, opts...)
	}
}

func call(c *grpc.ClientConn) (string, error) {
	r, err := hv1.NewHealthClient(c).Check(context.Background(), &hv1.HealthCheckRequest{})
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return r.Status.String(), nil
}

func stop(s *grpc.Server) { s.GracefulStop() }

// A gRPC service and client: the same output whichever World runs it.
func main() {
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("listen:", err)
		return
	}
	extra := grpc.ChainUnaryInterceptor(tag("sc1"))
	s := grpc.NewServer(grpc.UnaryInterceptor(tag("su")), extra, grpc.MaxRecvMsgSize(1<<20))
	hv1.RegisterHealthServer(s, health.NewServer())
	go s.Serve(ln)
	defer stop(s)

	if _, err := grpc.NewClient(ln.Addr().String()); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("no credentials:", err)
	}
	opts := []grpc.DialOption{grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials())}
	c, err := grpc.NewClient(ln.Addr().String(), append(opts, grpc.WithUnaryInterceptor(ctag("cu")), grpc.WithChainUnaryInterceptor(ctag("cc1")))...)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("client:", err)
		return
	}
	defer c.Close()
	st, err := call(c)
	fmt.Println("check:", st, err)
	mu.Lock()
	fmt.Println("order:", strings.Join(order, " "))
	mu.Unlock()
}
